title: plasmashell doesn't wait for kconf_update
line: Plasma now waits for settings updates to finish before starting the desktop, so upgraded settings like non-floating panels are kept.
explanation: kded runs kconf_update, but only after it has registered org.kde.kded6, and plasma-plasmashell.service was not ordered after plasma-kded6.service at all, so plasmashell started in parallel with the config migration. It then read the old config and wrote its defaults back, overwriting or pre-empting the update (e.g. panels turning floating after an upgrade). kded now runs kconf_update before claiming any D-Bus name, so systemd (Type=dbus) and plasma-session only consider it started once updates are done, and plasmashell's unit is ordered After=plasma-kded6.service.

commits.message:
Run kconf_update before registering on D-Bus

Kded ran kconf_update only after taking its D-Bus names, so whatever
waits for org.kde.kded6, like plasmashell, could start and rewrite its
config before it was migrated. Now the update runs before registering.

BUG: 483136

shell: start plasmashell after kded

Plasmashell did not wait for kded, which runs kconf_update, so it could
read and then rewrite its config before an update had migrated it, for
example making panels floating after an upgrade. Order it after kded.

BUG: 483136

patches.diff:
From 45b40633f20f68035fa3e5ab9c6d6bd7fba39fd7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:43:22 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Run kconf_update before registering on D-Bus

Kded ran kconf_update only after taking its D-Bus names, so whatever
waits for org.kde.kded6, like plasmashell, could start and rewrite its
config before it was migrated. Now the update runs before registering.

BUG: 483136
---
 src/kded.cpp | 5 +++--
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/kded.cpp b/src/kded.cpp
index a5482c1..530798a 100644
--- a/src/kded.cpp
+++ b/src/kded.cpp
@@ -550,6 +550,9 @@ int main(int argc, char *argv[])
         return 0;
     }
 
+    // Run it once before claiming any D-Bus name, so whoever waits for kded starts with updated config
+    runKonfUpdate();
+
     // Qt now has DBus in another thread, so we need to handle any messages
     // between the service registration and our paths existing
     // This means adding the spy now, so any received message gets
@@ -592,8 +595,6 @@ int main(int argc, char *argv[])
         (void)new KUpdateD; // Watch for updates
     }
 
-    runKonfUpdate(); // Run it once.
-
     return app.exec(); // keep running
 }
 
-- 
2.53.0

From fb81edf8cd77b9b541f1cc07b0663e1acafbd200 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:43:22 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] shell: start plasmashell after kded

Plasmashell did not wait for kded, which runs kconf_update, so it could
read and then rewrite its config before an update had migrated it, for
example making panels floating after an upgrade. Order it after kded.

BUG: 483136
---
 shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in b/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in
index 177c151e73..e74aa1e0c2 100644
--- a/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in
+++ b/shell/plasma-plasmashell.service.in
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 [Unit]
 Description=KDE Plasma Workspace
 After=plasma-ksmserver.service
+After=plasma-kded6.service
 PartOf=graphical-session.target
 StartLimitIntervalSec=60s
 StartLimitBurst=3
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: a kconf_update script sets the panel to non-floating, but plasmashell started before it finished, so the panel stays floating.
With the fix: plasmashell starts only after the update has finished, and the panel is non-floating as migrated.

review.text: Fixes the actual race at both ends: kded now runs kconf_update before taking its D-Bus names, so Type=dbus readiness means migrated config, and plasmashell's unit is ordered after kded. The cost is ~0.1-0.5 s when nothing is pending; none of the installed update scripts talk to kded over D-Bus, so no self-deadlock. Verified with a slow test .upd before/after.
